## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/registermcasmparser">RegisterMCAsmParser</a> - Helper template for registering a target specific assembly parser, for use in the target machine initialization function.</p>


<p>Usage:</p>


<p>extern "C" void LLVMInitializeFooMCAsmParser() { extern <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/target">Target</a> TheFooTarget; RegisterMCAsmParser&lt;FooAsmParser&gt; <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/tablegen/tablegenbackendskeleton-cpp/#ab60f28d7a141ac46ccc200176a1bca8b">X(TheFooTarget)</a>; }</p>
